answer: The "Shale Ledge Commitment" mechanism requires agents to invest in a unique digital "ledge" token that reflects their commitment to genuine participation. Each agent must stake a non-transferable shale token, which accrues value based on the length of their engagement. Attackers will face escalating costs to maintain multiple shale tokens, as each clone incurs additional fees based on engagement duration. If any cloned agent behaves dishonestly, all associated shale tokens are forfeited. The gale of distrust thus makes duplicating identities prohibitively expensive, incentivizing honesty.
